notes.title: Game Update: Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Detailed Notes:
We appreciate your continued support and feedback! Here's a breakdown of the bug fixes included in this update:

1. UI Resolution Handling Error Fixed:
- We've corrected a persistent issue where the judgment window failed to adapt properly to various UI resolutions. Previously, players might have experienced display inconsistencies. With this fix, the judgment window will now display correctly and consistently, regardless of your screen resolution settings. This ensures a smoother and more reliable visual experience during gameplay.

2. Status Window Information Not Updating Fixed:
- A bug that prevented character information in the status window from refreshing in real-time has been resolved. Previously, changes to character stats or status effects might not have been immediately reflected. Now, your character's details in the status window will always be accurately and instantly updated, providing you with precise information about your character's current state.

Thank you for your patience as we continue to improve the game! We're committed to delivering a stable and enjoyable experience for everyone.
